heading.title: Smart Food transforms local Chiang Mai restaurants into intelligent platforms powered by AI

paragraphs: Smart Food powers food service in Chiang Mai with an intelligent system that manages the full process, from receiving orders and recommending menus through chat to confirming purchases, handling payment flows, coordinating with the kitchen and delivery riders, and producing data summaries ready for business analysis.

For maximum convenience, the Smart Food platform supports multiple payment channels, including cash, QR Code scanning through banking applications such as PromptPay, and systems prepared to support government economic stimulus programs such as Thai Chuai Thai Plus.

We do more than make food ordering easier for customers. Smart Food is evolving into an All-in-One Restaurant OS that covers kitchen management, delivery service, automatic payment-slip verification, accounting systems, and internal operations, creating a strong foundation for sustainable food business growth.

heading.title: A closer look at the 5 intelligent steps of Smart Food AI

steps.title: 1. Order food easily through AI Chat
steps.text: Customers can choose favorite menus, ask for details, or confirm orders instantly through a simple and natural chat conversation.

image.alt: Smart Food intelligent AI Chat food ordering interface for customers

steps.title: 2. Process and verify bills automatically
steps.text: The AI system summarizes the order total, receives payment slips, and automatically verifies the payment amount before sending the order to the kitchen.

image.alt: Smart Food AI system summarizing bills and automatically verifying payment slips

steps.title: 3. Freshly cooked with kitchen team standards
steps.text: The kitchen team receives confirmed orders and starts cooking immediately with fresh ingredients under an accurate, standardized kitchen queue management system.

image.alt: Kitchen team carefully preparing food according to orders from the Smart Food system

steps.title: 4. Coordinate delivery dispatch
steps.text: The system alerts and forwards completed orders to local delivery riders immediately, preparing meals for fast delivery to customers.

image.alt: Smart Food system coordinating food delivery with local delivery riders

steps.title: 5. Receive hot food delivered directly
steps.text: Customers can pin their delivery location accurately and enjoy their favorite meals, completing a seamless food ordering experience.

image.alt: Delivery rider safely handing a completed food order to the customer
